comparator.name: Health and Society (Bachelor Gezondheid en Maatschappij)
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official handbook defines a 180-EC programme: 132 EC of named compulsory study, an 18-EC bachelor thesis and 30 EC of open electives. Current programme material confirms the half-year third-year elective space, health-policy and thesis sequence.

components.name: Research Methods in the Social Sciences
Global Challenges and Communication in a Changing World
Introduction to Epidemiology and Public Health
Preventing Disease and Improving Population Health
Health Demography and Global Population Transitions
Data Analysis for Health and Society
Literature Reviews for Health and Society
Minor and free-choice electives
components.note: Genuine open elective space in the third year; no minor or course package is invented.

notes.text: WUR offers a dedicated social-scientific health curriculum with sequenced epidemiology, health psychology, intervention design, policy, data analysis and an 18-EC thesis.
